# What a plugin's handler writes is stored, keyed by the import and the digest
# of the plugin's code, behind every input the handler recorded reading. A
# store hit runs nothing. An edit to the plugin, to a file it read, or to a
# file its output names in a literal `cache.inputs` directive -- what a
# process it ran reads, which no recorder can see -- is a miss.
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
grep 'v1 one' out/index.html
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'

# Nothing changed: the stored package answers.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
grep 'v1 one' out/index.html
stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'

# The plugin changed, and nothing it read did: a miss, or the old plugin's
# package would be replayed.
cp pc2.sngl pc/pc.sngl
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
grep 'v2 one' out/index.html

# A file the handler read changed.
cp data2.txt data.txt
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
grep 'v2 two' out/index.html

# A file only the output's literal directive names changed. The handler never
# read it, so only the directive can say the output depends on it.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
cp tool2.conf tool.conf
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --debug app.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import d "data:data.txt"
import "./pc"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=d.text)
}
-- data.txt --
one
-- data2.txt --
two
-- tool.conf --
first
-- tool2.conf --
second
-- pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="data", @generate(out, importPath) {
    var first = ""
    for var line = gen.lines(importPath) {
        first = line
    }
    out.write("data.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.file(path=\"tool.conf\")\n\}\n\nconst text = \"v1 " + first + "\"\n")
})
-- pc2.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="data", @generate(out, importPath) {
    var first = ""
    for var line = gen.lines(importPath) {
        first = line
    }
    out.write("data.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.file(path=\"tool.conf\")\n\}\n\nconst text = \"v2 " + first + "\"\n")
})
